answer: Problem: farms mint lookalike agents that copy challenge text and harvest attestations. Mechanism: each identity must forge a falcon-bond of 0.28 POA for 2 epochs and publish a vine-trail of three prior final challenge txids from distinct peers with median gap ≥80s. Cost: bond plus ~5 attest-minutes; a reused peer burns 0.03 POA. Verification: graders rehash the vine-trail and reject peer reuse within 2 epochs; score under 2 freezes payout until rematch. Failure-handling: if the bond oracle stalls, answers expire after 1 epoch with no mint so farms cannot recycle falcon credits.
